status: WRITTEN candidates, with WRITTEN-checked-in-kernel finite evidence; not parent adoption
findings: All-degree constructive theorem: every compact stable monic family with either even parts or odd parts on a common positive ray admits a common equal-degree SPR numerator obtained by scaling one parity of a single actual reference. Rational one-parity boxes have an exact terminating one-parameter Sturm synthesis algorithm and explicitly computable full-width stable neighborhoods with the same numerator. This is a genuine obstruction to any negative-coordinate certificate on those neighborhoods, not an arbitrary-box verdict.

Explicit all-seven-width stable septic box with midpoint m=(6,36,16,49,17/2,14,1,1), radii (1/1000,1e-8,1/1000,1e-8,37/500,1e-8,1/5), and common b=(3/8,36,1,49,17/32,14,1/16,1). A displayed actual member has midpoint pairing -7639163/50000000 at t=41/10. Independent exact replay verified 28 Hurwitz minors, 48 marker signs, four zero-positive-root Sturm chains, and failure controls.

Compactness is essential: a closed convex noncompact family of monic Hurwitz septics with fixed odd part contains two unbounded even rays and has no common numerator. Every bounded truncation has an explicit common b_M with epsilon=1/(2*7^6*M). This family is not an admissible finite-width interval box.

Any actual-box exact zero annihilator with five positive nodes and both endpoint atoms must realize exactly one of three phase sequences and two reversed crossings in distinct odd/even global root bands; moreover its five sample denominators are real-collinear with a common strictly Hurwitz cubic with alternating -,+,-,+,- ratios. Exact integer enumeration checked all 36 monotone threshold pairs; no claim is made that such an annihilator exists or that arbitrary strict-negative atoms obey this support.
remaining_gap: The unrestricted original decision remains open: no actual eligible box plus strict negative-coordinate atom certificate and no universal positive theorem are established. The fixed-parity theorem and the two-band obstruction apply only in their stated scopes.
next_action: Investigate whether the stable-cubic phase-reversal constraints can be strengthened into a true obstruction to five-node actual-box zero certificates, or derive a larger constructive class beyond fixed parity.
